Specification: This specification models a minimal one-variable state machine with state variable x. The initial state requires x = 1, and the next-state relation is defined as TRUE, so every step is allowed; the temporal specification is Init /\ [][Next]_vars, meaning all behaviors start in the initial state and then follow arbitrary Next steps modulo stuttering on vars. The property of interest is the invariant Inv == x < 1, which is intentionally false in the initial state, and the file also includes an embedded TLC configuration selecting Spec as the specification and Inv as the invariant to check.
